analytics_plan_code.description: An account description to include with analytics events.

category.description: An enum indicating the type of account. One of: "adobeid" (type 1), "enterprise" (type 2) or "federated" (type 3) or "business" (type 2e).

country_code.description: The country associated with this user.

email.description: Email address registered with this user.

first_name.description: A first name associated with this user.

first_time.description: A map of first-time indicators. e.g. dex_web_app. In the case of dex_web_app, this value will be true if they have never visited cloud.acrobat.com.

language.description: The language chosen for communication with this user.

last_name.description: A last name / family name associated with this user.

mrkt_perm_email.description: If true, the user has chosen to accept marketing material vie e-mail.

user_uri.description: The URI used to access this user.
